### The Little Apocalypse
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/little-apocalypse
Passage: Isaiah 24:1–23
Points:
- Isaiah 24 depicts the devastating and universal consequences of human sin upon the earth.
- Earthly wealth and social status cannot shield anyone from God's righteous judgment.
- Creation itself suffers under the defilement of sin, groaning until judgment and renewal come.
- God preserves a faithful remnant who rejoice in His righteous overthrow of evil.
- The Lord will ultimately triumph over all rebellious earthly rulers and spiritual powers.
- Security on the day of judgment is found solely in Christ's righteousness.
